# dislop

> Local, zero-dependency anti-slop linter for AI-written docs, Word/PowerPoint files, and web pages. Marks stray chat wrappers, placeholders, prose clichés, and AI slide/UI templates without rewriting your text. Works offline in Node.js 20+, Python 3.10+, MCP, and the browser.

Choose the page that matches the file you are reviewing. Each guide lists the checks to run and includes an example edit. Use the local CLI or MCP server to check a file.

## Start by task (~800-1,500 tokens each)
- [Review a brief or proposal](https://dislop.com/tasks/business-doc.md): AI artifacts and `business-brief` rules.
- [Check a web page or slide deck](https://dislop.com/tasks/web-and-deck.md): `deck-and-ui` rules and design tokens.
- [Edit an essay](https://dislop.com/tasks/editorial-writing.md): `literary-essay` rules and contrasts.
- [Check files before release](https://dislop.com/tasks/pre-release-gate.md): Core `error` checks and git diff CI gating.

## Browse by topic
- [Methodology & Voice Guide](https://dislop.com/methodology/index.md): Deletion Test, anti-pattern notes, plain voice guide, and visual tokens.
- [Examples & References](https://dislop.com/cases/index.md): Before / overcorrected / after contrasts and 31 print/type design references.
- [Install & Integrations](https://dislop.com/tools/index.md): Browser workbench, `SKILL.md`, CLI (`npx`/`uvx`), MCP server, and CI hooks.
- [Awesome Anti-Slop](https://dislop.com/awesome/index.md): 87 checked tools, guides, and papers (`dislop.radar/2`, raw JSON at `/awesome/index.json`).
- [Roadmap & Open Questions](https://dislop.com/roadmap.md): Active tracks (`v0.3` -> `v0.4+`) and collaboration guide.

## Machine index & packs
- [JSON Catalog](https://dislop.com/catalog.json): Versioned manifest (`dislop.catalog/1`) with sha256 and token estimates.
- [Agent Skill](https://dislop.com/tools/skill.md): `check -> edit -> re-check` workflow instructions.
- [Rule Packs](https://dislop.com/packs/core.md): Also `/packs/business-brief.md`, `/packs/literary-essay.md`, `/packs/deck-and-ui.md`, and 25 `/rules/<id>.md` cards.
- [Single-Fetch Bundle](https://dislop.com/llms-full.txt): All 25 rules compiled without test fixtures.
